plans.idea: Centered poster stack that reads top to bottom: logo, then a big headline and subhead, then a large centered bottle, with the CTA closing the column. Everything sits on one central axis so the copy is no longer pushed to the left edge.
Product first: a large bottle fills the top half, and below it a left-aligned editorial block (headline, subhead, then CTA) shares a strong left edge with the logo in the top-left corner.

Keeps the original's two-column structure, scaled up for the tall canvas: the bottle sits large on the left, the headline, subhead and CTA stack on the right at the same height, and the logo is centered across the top.
